name: Ailis
source:
Ailis appears withdrawn and apathetic. She doesn't get along with her counterpart Cerise, but she seems to open up to Einar. She's shy and kindhearted.

[From [url=https://cosmic-latte.itch.io/starlit-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
